The upstream series, visual memory and preset texts are used as visual direction context by the OpenCut storyboard adapter. OpenCut adds shot timing, camera/motion/continuity, media generation and timeline transitions. Upstream Markdown references describe its full workflow; this integration implements the series planning and style-lock stages, not automatic image quality scoring.
